fields.description: Master switch for everything this app wires between Frappe CRM and ERPNext. Turn it off to disable the linkage without uninstalling the app.
fields.label: Enable CRM ↔ ERPNext Linkage

fields.description: Company that CRM deals are sold under. Used as the default on documents raised from a deal.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Move the deal to the status below when a quotation raised against it is submitted. Forward only — a deal already further along the pipeline is left where it is.
fields.label: Advance Deal Status

fields.description: Stamp the submitted sales order onto the CRM Deal it originated from, so the order is reachable from the deal without walking the quotation chain.
fields.label: Link Sales Order to Deal

fields.description: Close the deal as won when a sales order against it is submitted. Off by default — many teams close the deal by hand after collecting the advance.
fields.label: Close Deal as Won

fields.description: Status a ticket opens in when nobody picked one — including every ticket created from an inbound support email.
fields.label: Default Status

fields.description: Priority a ticket opens at when nobody picked one.
fields.label: Default Priority

fields.description: Team an unrouted ticket lands with. Leave empty to leave new tickets unrouted.
fields.label: Default Team

fields.description: The support mailbox. Naming it here makes tender_crm.setup.configure_ticket_email_intake set that account's append_to to Ticket, so mail arriving on it opens a ticket and replies thread onto it. Create the Email Account and enter its credentials yourself — this app never writes mail credentials.
fields.label: Support Email Account
